blocks.text: 9. The Respondent Authority is directed to complete the transfer formalities in respect of Plot No. 2, Sector Ecotech-IV, Greater Noida in favour of the Revisionist without insisting upon payment of the construction/functional delay and time-extension charges set aside by this order. The Respondent Authority shall undertake a fresh reconciliation of the account, give due credit for the amount of ₹3,13,90,201/- lying towards excess premium, to the extent applicable, and communicate to the Revisionist, by a reasoned statement of account, any lawful post-acquisition dues, if remaining. The revision petition is accordingly disposed of in the above terms.
